data.title: Kinderzuschlag Bescheid — Familienkasse Musterlahn
data.case_title: Kinderzuschlag for Ida and Jonas (Familienkasse Musterlahn)
data.summary: The Familienkasse Musterlahn grants Johanna Beispielacker Kinderzuschlag (supplementary child benefit) of €297.00 per month for each of her children, Ida and Jonas, from December 2026 to May 2027, based on her income and housing costs. The decision also opens the right to apply separately for education and participation benefits (Leistungen für Bildung und Teilhabe) at her local municipality.
data.explanation: This is an official decision (Bescheid) granting you extra child benefit on top of regular Kindergeld, for six months. No action is needed to receive the payments, which should be transferred automatically. However, you may separately apply for additional education and participation benefits at your municipality (Kommune) — this is not automatic. If you disagree with the decision (e.g. the amount), you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline. Consider seeking advice from a Familienkasse advisor or Sozialberatung if you believe the amount is wrong.

items.title: Deadline to file an objection (Widerspruch) against the Kinderzuschlag decision
items.action: If you disagree with the decision, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Familienkasse Musterlahn, or lodge it in person for the record there.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the decision becomes final and can usually no longer be challenged.
